plans.idea: Split layout: a large bottle fills the left column as the anchor, and a centred brand stack on the right (logo, one-line headline, subhead, a CTA sized to the button) reads top to bottom, unlike the engine's tiny bottle and oversized button.
Banner-style layout read left to right: the logo, headline, subhead and CTA share one left edge, and the bottle runs the full height on the right as the payoff, with generous margins.
Faithful centred stack on one vertical axis, as in the original: logo at the top, bottle in the centre, a wide text band so the headline stays on one line, and a modest CTA at the bottom.
